text:
This looks like chopped hard-boiled egg whites with a mashed yolk (or a similar orange mash) on a square plate.

Egg whites: roughly 4 whites at about 33 g each, so about 130 g. At about 17 kcal per white, that is about 70 kcal.

The orange mash is about 50 g. If it is mashed yolk (about 55 kcal per yolk), it could be 2–3 yolks, or about 100 kcal. If it is a hummus-like or sweet potato mash, the figure would be similar or lower.

Total mass is about 180 g. Total energy is about 170 kcal.

{"kcal": 170, "mass_g": 180}
